description: Create one location (Standort) of the company and return its id and name. Use it for companies with several sites whose results should be compared; single-site companies do not need locations. Idempotent: if a location with exactly this name exists, that one is returned and nothing is duplicated. Not needed before safe_mind_create_survey, which creates missing locations by name itself. Locations cannot be renamed or deleted through the API. Requires an API key: set SAFE_MIND_API_KEY or call safe_mind_get_api_key first. Acts on the company of the account behind the key.

name.description: Name of the site as employees know it, e.g. "Hamburg" or "Werk Süd". Matched exactly (case-sensitive) against existing locations.

name: safe_mind_create_location
